stories.title: HOF Induction Ceremony — Beltran, Jones, and Kent Enter Cooperstown

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Three legends entered Cooperstown yesterday.

Beltran. Jones. Kent.

Jones: first player from Curacao ever inducted. Beltran dedicated his speech to Puerto Rico. Kent needed tissues looking at his parents.

57 HOFers on stage. A new record. Baseball at its best.

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Andruw Jones made history in Cooperstown yesterday.

The first player from Curacao inducted into the Hall of Fame. His speech was described as a love letter to the island he came from.

When baseball is at its best, it sounds like that.

stories.title: Mike Trout Goes 4-for-4, Passes Tim Salmon on Angels Doubles List

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Mike Trout went 4-for-4 on Saturday.

His first four-hit game since April 2021 — the 21st of his career.

His double, No. 340, moved him past Tim Salmon into 2nd all-time on the Angels franchise doubles list.

Only Garrett Anderson's 489 is ahead of him. #Angels

stories.title: White Sox 54-48, Leading AL Central — The Rebuild That Won't Stop

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
The Chicago White Sox are in first place at 54-48.

In 2024 they lost 121 games — an MLB record.
In 2025 they lost 102.
In 2026 they're leading the AL Central.

One of the most remarkable turnarounds in baseball history. #WhiteSox
